slides.headline: YOU DON'T NEED A $15,000 PROPOSAL CONSULTANT. YOU NEED THESE 5 PROMPTS
MOST PROPOSALS LOSE BEFORE ANYONE READS PAGE TWO
slides.body:
Most buyers form their opinion in the first paragraph and almost never change it.

AI writes it the way a $15,000 consultant would: the client's pain first, your services second.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE THE OPENER THAT PROVES YOU UNDERSTAND THEM
slides.body:
Clients who feel understood before the pitch sign faster.

The prompt asks AI to describe the problem from the client's perspective, ending with what it costs them each month.

slides.headline: 2) TURN YOUR PRICE INTO THE SMALL NUMBER IN THE ROOM
slides.body:
For any service over $2,000, this section reframes your fee as the smaller number.

It shows the dollar cost of the problem first, then what you produce, then the math.

slides.headline: THEY DECIDED ON PAGE ONE
slides.body: **Decision-makers** at most companies form their opinion before they reach your pricing section. The opener either earns the read or loses it. The next three prompts build the pages that follow.

slides.headline: 3) ADD THE SECTION THAT MAKES SAYING NO FEEL RISKY
slides.body:
Loss aversion is twice as powerful as the desire to gain.

This prompt adds the cost of not hiring you: two sentences, calm and factual, making the outcome feel inevitable.

slides.headline: 4) TURN YOUR BEST RESULT INTO THREE SENTENCES THAT CLOSE DEALS
slides.body:
You probably have one result you are genuinely proud of.

This prompt turns it into a 3-sentence case study: lead with the result number, make a skeptical reader believe it.

slides.headline: 5) WRITE THE PAGE EVERY DECISION-MAKER ACTUALLY READS
slides.body:
Most proposals bury the answer on page 6.

CEOs skip to the last page, find no summary, and close the document.

Put this page at the front, not the back.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 5 PROPOSAL PROMPTS
slides.body:
Problem mirror opener
ROI section that shrinks the price
Cost of inaction warning
30-second case study
Executive summary CEOs read

Daily AI news plus real skills.
